messages.author: 807d7202cc09a8b1
messages.subject: attempt to apply non-function
parts:
Hi all,
I'm attempting to get rattle working to do some data exploration. Unfortunately I'm running into issues. 

when I call rattle(). Rattle's GUI shows up and I get an error in the terminal.
> rattle()
Error in resetRattle(FALSE) : attempt to apply non-function

I get the following error when trying to load data with the spreadsheet option
(R:16487): Gtk-WARNING **: Attempting to store changes into `/Users/scottpage/.local/share/recently-used.xbel', but failed: Failed to create file '/Users/scottpage/.local/share/recently-used.xbel.EE1EBX': No such file or directory

(R:16487): Gtk-WARNING **: Attempting to set the permissions of `/Users/scottpage/.local/share/recently-used.xbel', but failed: No such file or directory

I have installed gtk through homebrew
Any ideas? Many thanks,
Scott


My setup is:

> rattleInfo()
Rattle: version 3.0.2 r169 cran 3.0.2
R: version 3.0.2 (2013-09-25) (Revision 63987)

Sysname: Darwin
Release: 13.0.2
Version: Darwin Kernel Version 13.0.2: Sun Sep 29 19:38:57 PDT 2013; root:xnu-2422.75.4~1/RELEASE_X86_64

parts:
Version 3.0.3 of Rattle has fixed this issue. Thanks to Akbar Waljee and Christopher T. Lowenkamp for assistance in solving the bug.

To install this version before the CRAN update please use:

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com", type="source")

Graham Williams
